name: EB-1 (Extraordinary Ability / Outstanding Researcher-Professor / Multinational Manager-Executive)

value.note: meet at least 3 of 10 regulatory criteria (Kazarian two-step), then a final merits determination of sustained national/international acclaim

requirements.blocker_text: This requires meeting at least 3 of 10 regulatory criteria demonstrating sustained national or international acclaim, then passing a final merits determination — no job offer or employer sponsorship needed.
requirements.fix_path: Build a documented record against the Kazarian criteria (awards, publications, media coverage, judging others' work, high salary, etc.).

requirements.blocker_text: This requires an employer offer, at least 3 years' experience in the field, and international recognition as outstanding in the specific academic field.
This requires a qualifying multinational employer relationship and at least 1 year of employment abroad in a managerial/executive capacity within the prior 3 years.

evidence_required.document: Documented evidence portfolio against the applicable sub-category's criteria

outcome.duration_length: indefinite — leads directly to a green card (LPR status) on approval; no PERM required

sources.title: Employment-Based Immigration: First Preference EB-1 - USCIS

notes: GENUINE COUNTRY-OF-BIRTH BACKLOG confirmed as of the Aug 2026 Visa Bulletin (Final Action Dates): EB-1 China July 1, 2023; EB-1 India Oct 15, 2022 (State Dept warns EB-1 India 'may become unavailable in coming weeks' before FY2026 ends); all other countries Current. This means pr_after_months (0) is accurate ONLY for applicants not born in India or China — a real and consequential per-country variance the schema's single-figure outcome block can't fully capture; flagged here rather than glossed over. EB-1A is the only self-petition route encoded for the US with genuinely no job offer or PERM required, similar in spirit to UK Global Talent — the most portable, employer-independent US work-to-settlement route in this dataset.
